## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` passes locally
- [ ] New host behavior has a vitest (or is listed in `docs/TEST-EXCEPTIONS.md` with a reason)
- [ ] User-facing change: docs updated (and `shared/openapi.yaml` if routes changed)
- [ ] Non-trivial change: RFC added under `docs/rfcs/` and listed in `docs/rfcs/README.md`
- [ ] No tokens, keys, personal hostnames or IP addresses in the diff
